doctrine.overview: 53-segment mixed-source doc: Reddit platform threads (segs 1-9, skip), then instructional video transcripts covering GA4 analytics, Notion/Airtable CRM architecture, Claude Code workflows, deployment patterns, SEO/GEO authority, web performance, and Claude skill systems. 15% boilerplate stripped. Remaining content is dense operational doctrine.

1_analytics_ga4.title: GA4 Configuration Doctrine
rules: Key events (formerly conversions) must be defined before audiences are built -- sequence matters.
Attribution window default is 30-day last-click; adjust to data-driven if volume supports it.
GA4 audiences built on key events, not pageviews -- page-based audiences are legacy GA3 thinking.
GA4 does not sample under 10M events/day; above that, use BigQuery export for analysis.
Segment exploration (vs. report filters) is the correct tool for cohort-level questions.

2_notion_crm_architecture.title: Notion CRM + Database Design
rules: Icon consistency across all database views is a non-negotiable design signal -- one icon set, enforced.
Layout templates (page templates per record type) prevent blank-page friction; build before launch.
Notion Mail database has a known discovery bug -- manually navigate to it; do not rely on sidebar auto-population.
Two-way relations in Notion require manual setup on both sides; no automatic bi-directional link.
AI co-authoring phases: outline (AI), draft (AI), edit (human), publish (human) -- never invert.
Grid view for data entry; Kanban only for pipeline stage tracking -- do not default to Kanban.

3_airtable_crm_automation.title: Airtable Automation + Integration Patterns
rules: Automation trigger logic: email-to-contact match (field lookup) fires before any deal record is created.
Deal-to-contract trigger: status field change to 'Closed Won' is the canonical fire condition.
Calendar sync via Airtable automation: use the Airtable native Google Calendar block, not Zapier, for latency reasons.
Form intake flows write to a staging table first; a automation then promotes to the live CRM table after validation.
Prefer deterministic automation over AI for any logic that has a binary correct answer -- AI is a fallback, not default.
Two-way integrations (e.g., bidirectional Slack + Airtable) require a loop-guard field to prevent infinite triggers.

4_deployment_patterns.title: Deployment Automation (Modal / Trigger.dev / Loops)
rules: Three deployment patterns in scope: (a) loops (recurring polling jobs), (b) scheduled tasks (cron-style), (c) modal/trigger.dev (event-driven serverless).
Modal is preferred for GPU-heavy or bursty workloads; Trigger.dev for orchestrated multi-step pipelines; loops for simple polling.
Multicontext plan persistence: write the plan to a GitHub issue before execution begins so any agent instance can resume from it.
Dynamic workflows for large-scale processing: break job into fan-out subtasks, each writing result to a shared store, then a reducer step aggregates.
Render and Fly.io are better cost fits than Vercel for always-on background workers -- Vercel is optimized for request/response, not long-running.
DigitalOcean App Platform is the simplest managed container path if the team has no Kubernetes familiarity.

5_claude_code_workflow.title: Claude Code Development Workflow
rules: Canonical 4-phase flow: Explore (read codebase, no edits) → Plan (write plan to GitHub issue) → Code (implement) → Commit (with test pass gate).
Never skip Explore phase -- jumping straight to Code produces architecturally inconsistent patches.
Sub-agents: use Haiku for parallelizable subtasks (token cost); use Sonnet/Opus for the main orchestration agent.
Devil's advocate agent: spin a second agent whose sole job is to critique the primary agent's plan before execution -- catches assumption errors.
SaaS payment integration via Stripe MCP + Supabase MCP: Stripe handles checkout sessions; Supabase stores entitlement rows; webhook updates the row.
Worktrees: use git worktrees to run parallel Claude Code sessions on the same repo without branch conflicts.
Remote control mode: Claude Code can be driven via API for headless CI automation -- use for nightly audit runs.
Context management: /compact before context window fills; never let context overflow silently corrupt the agent's working memory.

6_claude_code_hacks_32.title: 32 Claude Code Hacks (Beginner / Intermediate / Pro)
beginner: Use /help to discover commands before asking Claude what it can do.
Set permissions in settings.json upfront -- repeated permission prompts break flow.
Use numbered lists in prompts to force sequential execution of multi-step tasks.
Add 'think step by step' to any prompt where order of operations matters.
intermediate: MCP tool selection: load only the MCPs relevant to the current task -- unused MCPs waste context.
Sub-agent spawning: pass the full plan as the sub-agent's system prompt, not just the current step.
Loop detection: if Claude is repeating the same edit, inject 'stop and describe what is blocking you' to break the loop.
Parallel workflows: open multiple Claude Code windows on different worktrees for non-conflicting parallel work.
Scoping buckets: label every feature Core / Nice / Maybe / Out before coding begins -- prevents scope creep mid-session.
pro: Remote control via API: automate Claude Code sessions for nightly audits or batch processing.
Token optimization: Haiku for sub-agents doing mechanical tasks (file reads, searches); Opus for reasoning-heavy orchestration.
Multicontext plan persistence: write the plan to a GitHub issue so any resumed session has ground truth.
Devil's advocate agent: second agent critiques primary agent's plan before execution.
Context-window hygiene: /compact proactively; never fill to overflow.

7_claude_skills_catalog.title: Claude Skills Architecture + Catalog
architecture_rules: Skills route via trigger phrases -- every skill needs a unique, unambiguous trigger that does not collide with other skills.
Skill structure: system prompt + optional tool list + optional knowledge doc. Keep each skill single-purpose.
find-skills skill is the meta-router -- it lists available skills and routes to the correct one.
decision-framer skill applies a structured template: situation / options / criteria / recommendation / next action.
expand-and-contract skill: expand a concept to full detail, then contract to a one-liner -- useful for positioning and copy work.
production_skills_profiled: skill-creator: builds new skills from description
day-planner: time-blocks the day from a task list
watch-video: extracts doctrine from video transcripts
newsletter-skill: formats and publishes newsletter issues
decision-skill: structured decision output with trade-off table
ishan_sharma_skills: caveman: simplifies complex explanations to first-principles language
humanizer: strips AI tells from copy
hook-forge: generates 10 hook variants per angle
infographic-builder: converts data to visual layout spec
karpathy-guidelines: applies Andrej Karpathy's LLM prompting best practices

8_seo_geo_authority.title: SEO + GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Doctrine
topical_authority: Topical authority requires full cluster coverage -- a single pillar page without spokes has no topical signal.
4-phase content creation: research cluster gaps → outline → draft → on-page optimize before publish.
On-page SEO checklist (8 elements): title tag with primary keyword, H1 match, meta description, URL slug, internal links (editorial in-paragraph only), image alt text, schema markup, page speed pass.
CRITICAL: navigation links (footer, mega-menu) pass zero link authority. Only editorial in-paragraph links count.
Link-building pyramid: citations/mentions at base, guest posts in middle, editorial links from DR70+ at top.
geo_metrics_5_signals: AI citations: is the domain cited by ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini for target queries?
Brand search surge: rising branded query volume signals LLM-driven awareness.
Predictive traffic: model projects traffic from citation share, not just ranking.
GEO metrics: citation frequency per LLM per query cluster.
Conversion lift: did AI-referred visitors convert at a higher rate than organic?
8_seo_geo_authority.critical_insight: Rankings and AI citations are completely uncorrelated. A site can rank #1 and be invisible to LLMs, or rank page 3 and get cited constantly. Optimize for both independently.
8_seo_geo_authority.ai_citation_rule: 75% of AI citations go to sources outside Google top 10. Citation is driven by content depth and entity clarity, not rank position.
8_seo_geo_authority.gpt_version_risk: GPT model version upgrades cause up to 7x swings in citation rates for the same query. Citation share is volatile; monitor monthly.
8_seo_geo_authority.boring_marketer_proof: Local service site built with Claude Code in 4 hours, zero coding background, generating revenue in 24 hours. The moat shifted from code skill to vertical expertise -- knowing what questions to ask is the new differentiator.

google_business_profile: Select up to 10 categories -- primary category is the strongest signal.
8 consistency signals: NAP (name/address/phone) must match exactly across 8+ directories.
Post weekly to GBP -- recency is a local ranking factor.
core_30_page_structure: 25-30 service pages (one per specific service + city combination)
local_seo_system.rank_map_decision_tree: Below ranking threshold for a service: add topical content (more depth on that service). Above threshold: add geographical content (new city/neighborhood pages).

9_web_performance.title: Web Performance + Core Web Vitals
rules: Preload only critical above-fold resources -- preloading non-critical resources delays LCP.
Never lazy-load above-fold images -- lazy loading above-fold causes LCP regression.
Lazy-load everything below the fold.
GPU animation: use transform and opacity only -- any other property triggers layout/paint.
Separate DOM reads from writes in JS to avoid layout thrashing (read all, then write all).
AVIF is the preferred image format; WebP as fallback; JPEG as last resort.
WordPress stack: Breeze (page cache) + Object Cache Pro (Redis object cache) + AVIF/WebP conversion plugin.
Cloudways provides the managed server layer for this WordPress stack.
Security headers are context-dependent -- CSP strictness must not break third-party scripts; audit before enforce.

segments_to_skip.segs_1_to_9: Reddit platform comparison threads (Vercel/AWS/DO/Netlify/Render/Fly.io) and GTD tool threads. Heavy boilerplate, ads, upvote counts, removed comments. No extractable doctrine unless deployment tool benchmarking is an active decision.

cross_cutting_rules: Deterministic logic always beats AI inference for binary-correct decisions (automation, routing, triggers).
Plan persistence via GitHub issue is the correct multicontext ground truth -- not chat history.
Sub-agent token tier: Haiku for mechanical tasks, Sonnet/Opus for reasoning. Never inverse.
Citation optimization (GEO) and ranking optimization (SEO) are separate workstreams with separate tactics.
Vertical expertise (knowing what to ask) is now the moat, not technical execution skill.
Navigation links carry zero link authority; only editorial in-paragraph links count.

notes: Segments 1-9 are low-signal Reddit scrapes; all doctrine extracted from segments 10-53. File is a heterogeneous transcript collection (GA4, Notion, Airtable, Claude Code, SEO/GEO, web perf, skills). Signal rated high because segments 10-53 contain dense, directly actionable operating doctrine across 9 distinct capability domains. No repetition after consolidation from 6 partials.
